title: Can you do adventure sports if you can't swim?
hook: Scared of water? Read this first.
cta: Save, send to a friend who asked

facts.claim: Which water activities are commonly run for non-swimmers with a life jacket and a guide
facts.note: Confirm against operator policies rather than general advice — this is the one post where a wrong answer has a cost.

notes: The answer is 'for some things, with the right operator' — and the post is really about what an operator should tell you before you book. Keep it to what any instructor would say; no reassurance that outruns the facts.
